simple.meaning: something prepared , i.e. any apparatus (as an implement, utensil, dress, vessel or weapon)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כְּלִי (H3627) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 325 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: כְּלִי (kᵉlîy) means something prepared , i.e. any apparatus (as an implement, utensil, dress, vessel or weapon) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 9 28.

definitions.short: something prepared , i.e. any apparatus (as an implement, utensil, dress, vessel or weapon)
definitions.usage: armour(-bearer), artillery, bag, carriage, furnish, furniture, instrument, jewel, that is made of, × one from another, that which pertaineth, pot, psaltery, sack, stuff, thing, tool, vessel, ware, weapon, whatsoever.
definitions.full: H3627. keli כְּלִי 324 noun masculine Hosea 8:8 article, utensil, vessel (Late Hebrew id. ; according to Thes from כלה = conficere , like German Zeug from zeugen ; properly therefore anything finished, made, produced ; according to Ba ZMG 1887, 605 from meaning enclose, contain ; he finds plural of כְּלִי in כלאי M-I:23 (compare כלאים )) — ׳כ absolute Jer 18:4 +; הַכֶּ֑לִי 1Sam 17:49 ; 21:6 ; construct כְּלִי Hosea 13:15 +; suffix כֶּלְיְךָ Deut 23:25 ; plural כֵּלִים Exod 22:6 +; construct כְּלֵי Gen 24:53 +; suffix כֵּלַי 31:37 2 t.; כֵּלֶיךָ 27:3 ; Ezek 12:4 ; כֵּלֵינוּ 1Sam 9:7 ; כְּלֵיכֶם Gen 43:11 +; כְּלֵיהֶם Josh 7:11 +;
